sentence: This project studies mathematical models of tumor growth and of attacks that fool machine learning classification systems, focusing on the boundaries between regions.
This project studies how electrospray ionization mass spectrometry works and tries to make it work at much smaller currents and flow rates.
This project builds a tool that uses drones with infrared sensors and deep learning to detect, track and forecast embers that spread wildfires.
This project builds ways to detect radar signals among strong wireless signals using machine learning and antenna design.
This project gets an instrument that works across a wide range of frequencies to test wireless communication, sensing and imaging.
This project studies ways to confirm a person's identity from body measurements and to protect identity systems against images and recordings made to deceive.
This project builds an image sensor inspired by arthropod eyes to track objects and sense depth.
This project builds a tissue-engineered platform that tests cancer drugs in a setting closer to the tumor microenvironment.
This project studies trace formulas and how they apply to number theory.
This project builds a digital platform that helps patients with food allergies follow oral immunotherapy treatment and lets healthcare professionals check progress remotely.
This project studies how superconducting quantum bits can be coupled to surface waves in a piezoelectric crystal.
This project builds tools that track how scientific datasets were generated and used, and finds suspicious data behaviors without sharing sensitive raw data.
This project develops hydrogen exchange methods to find out how sequence changes affect the conformations of a protein, including the spike protein.
This project builds ways to detect phishing websites using large language models and forced execution of program elements.
This project develops a method to track RNA in living cells using fluorescent building blocks that cells incorporate.
This project builds computer methods to simulate high-temperature plasmas, including how collisions and nuclear fusion reactions change their behavior.
This project builds mathematical tools that help neural networks separate the shapes of objects in images from the transformations applied to them.
This project builds a way for wireless networks to send the meaning of information while protecting private details, using models that understand images and text.
This project builds a community around open-source mobile applications that help plant breeders collect data in the field.
This project builds an open-source pipeline to analyze genome-scale data from microbial species, using machine learning to detect contaminants and gene transfers.
